en: Colorized historic view of a broad cobblestoned market square framed by old townhouses. In the center background stands a two‑story building with a small tower and hipped roof, partly covered by trees and a monument or fountain in front. Few pedestrians are visible, and church spires rise in the distant background. Printed titling at the top left reads "Geithain. Marktplatz." indicating the town and square.
